name: devmate-agent
description: Local-first agent capability and automation runtime for ChatGPT via MCP, with files, Git, commands, browser control, durable jobs, VS Code, Obsidian, and Runners.

devMate.autoStart.description: Bring the shared DevMate connection to Ready automatically after VS Code opens a workspace. By default this attaches without changing the machine Current Project.

devMate.activateWorkspaceOnAutoStart.description: Also make this VS Code workspace the machine-wide Current Project during automatic startup. Leave disabled for deterministic multi-window behavior; manual DevMate Start always activates the current project.

devMate.sharedStateDirectory.description: Optional shared DevMate state directory override. Leave empty to use the machine-wide ~/.devmate/desktop instance shared by VS Code and Obsidian.

devMate.port.description: Preferred internal loopback Gateway port. An existing shared Gateway port remains authoritative.

devMate.ngrokUseManagedAccount.description: Use the ngrok account saved in VS Code Secret Storage. Fresh installs use the machine's normal ngrok configuration until this is enabled by setup.

devMate.ngrokUrl.description: Optional machine-local stable ngrok URL candidate used by Connection Setup. The active runtime URL is shared by the machine-wide desktop instance.

devMate.ngrokPoolingEnabled.description: Allow ngrok endpoint pooling only when intentionally serving the same trusted DevMate instance from multiple agents.

devMate.publicUrl.description: Optional machine-local stable HTTPS URL candidate for managed Cloudflare or external ingress. The active runtime URL is shared by the machine-wide desktop instance.

devMate.tunnelAutoRestart.description: Restart an owned public connection process after unexpected exit.

devMate.tunnelMaxRestarts.description: Maximum automatic public connection restarts after unexpected exit.

devMate.autoCopyUrl.description: Copy the public MCP URL only after DevMate reaches verified Ready state.

devMate.autoUseCurrentWorkspace.description: Register the current VS Code folder as a writable DevMate workspace during host refresh. This does not change the machine Current Project.

devMate.authenticationMode.description: MCP authentication mode. none is the default single-owner mode for local and public MCP access; oauth is for team/shared member identity.

devMate.permissionProfile.description: Permission preset. readOnly blocks mutation; balanced uses configurable safety guards; fullAccess grants unrestricted DevMate development operations inside trusted writable workspaces while credential/path, OS, and remote identity boundaries remain enforced.

devMate.blockDangerousOperations.description: Balanced mode only: block recognized destructive shell and Git patterns. fullAccess intentionally bypasses this extra guard.

devMate.confirmBeforePush.description: Balanced mode only: block Git push while this guard is enabled. fullAccess never applies this extra guard.

devMate.allowDirectoryMutations.description: Balanced mode only: allow directory move/delete operations after normal workspace and sensitive-path checks. fullAccess always allows them.

devMate.defaultCommandTimeoutMs.description: Default command timeout for the shared Gateway.

devMate.maxOutputChars.description: Maximum returned command output for the shared Gateway.

devMate.backupRetentionDays.description: Backup retention period for shared DevMate state.

devMate.auditRetentionDays.description: Audit retention period for shared DevMate state.

devMate.maxBackupBytes.description: Maximum retained backup bytes in shared DevMate state.

devMate.maxAuditBytes.description: Maximum audit log bytes in shared DevMate state.

devMate.defaultStartCommand.description: Optional project command started after the local Gateway is ready.

devMate.embeddedRunnerEnabled.description: Enable the in-process durable Job runner for the machine-wide shared Gateway on its next Shared Runtime start. Disabled by default; external Runners remain available.

scripts.build:obsidian: npm run version:check && node obsidian-plugin/esbuild.config.mjs && node scripts/check-obsidian-release.mjs --dist
scripts.check: npm run version:check && node scripts/check-repository.mjs && node scripts/check-workflows.mjs && node scripts/check-obsidian-release.mjs
scripts.smoke:gateway: npm run build && node tests/smoke-gateway.mjs && node tests/smoke-local-capabilities.mjs
